name: 29483 · Summerville, SC
findings: ZIP 29483 (Summerville) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29483 (Summerville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29483 (Summerville) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
